name: brainwave
description: AI-powered brainstorming that turns ideas into action

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
